criteria.requirement: Implement ArgumentParser.parse_result with the existing parse_known_args inputs and a public ParseResult. Return actual parsed Namespace, ordered unknown tuple and source records identifying dest/value without retaining argparse.Action objects. Snapshot deeply at completion and return independent namespace/source accessor copies, including mutable defaults, append lists and custom Namespace attributes. Reusing the parser, changing defaults, mutating caller namespace/accessor values or a later failed parse must not change the earlier result. Keep parse_args and get_source_to_settings_dict behavior unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
